about: Every group of Reelix's API routes (/api/v1/<group>/...) and where Starboard covers it: 'starboard' says where it is shown or used, 'task' names the task that will, 'not_for_lite' says why it is not needed. tests/test_reelix_routes.py fails when Reelix adds a group with no decision (DASH-177). Check against a running Reelix with REELIX_OPENAPI=http://host:7700/api/v1/openapi.json.

albums.what: Library albums (read in DASH-163), follow and change

auth.starboard: The set-up's admin and key (reelix_setup.py), the admin password dialog (DASH-154)

authors.what: Library authors (read in DASH-163), follow and change

bookimport.what: bring in books already on disk

bookrootfolders.what: folders after set-up (made at set-up today)

books.what: Library books (read in DASH-163), follow and change

command.what: refresh and rescan; RescanRadioLibrary is used by Settings, Radio, Read the library again (DASH-212)

customformats.what: quality in full; language rules in DASH-189

customitems.starboard: Library, Bring them in, Use my own details: a folder with no match (DASH-322); Reelix does not have it yet (RFX-90), so Starboard offers it only when Reelix's openapi.json lists POST /api/v1/customitems

downloads.not_for_lite: YouTube and Spotify downloads exist only in the full Reelix: DASH-216, DASH-217; their health in Reelix's health on Apps and System (DASH-218)

episodes.what: episodes on item pages (read in DASH-163), follow and change

indexers.starboard: Settings, Reelix, Sites to search, with each site's results (DASH-155), and Site list updates (DASH-204); Search, Search the sites (DASH-213)

libraryimport.what: bring in films and series already on disk

movies.what: Library films (read in DASH-163), follow and change

musicimport.starboard: Library, Music, Bring them in: artist folders already on disk (DASH-282)

parse.not_for_lite: a test tool for release names

pending.starboard: Activity, Downloads, Held downloads: Get it now and Remove (DASH-210)

profile.not_for_lite: each Reelix user's own notification choices; Starboard has its own alerts

radio.starboard: Coming up and Library, Radio; following shows DASH-158, settings DASH-181; Settings, Radio: the library review with matching by hand and a show from a link (DASH-212)

releases.what: choose a download for an item; the raw grab (POST /releases/grab) is used by Search, Search the sites (DASH-213)

rootfolders.starboard: Made at set-up (reelix_setup.py); changed later in DASH-194

series.what: Library series (read in DASH-163), follow and change

settings.starboard: Settings, Reelix, Sites to search (indexer settings) and Site list updates (definitions, DASH-204); the rest in DASH-188, 193, 195, 197, 200

system.starboard: Health on Apps and System (DASH-176), updates through Starboard (DASH-187), moving in (reelix_move.py); backups DASH-201, logs DASH-202, jobs DASH-203, pace DASH-200

{kind}.starboard: Settings, Reelix forms from Reelix's own description (DASH-154); notifications and lists in DASH-198
